epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, shes soon framed for her husbands murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫.小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇.直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convoy Master Lis wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Lis Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉.最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 街頭浪蕩客孟剛與鐵虎雖玩世不恭,卻心懷俠義.一次偶然,孟剛結識革命軍首領萬泰,在其感召下,兩兄弟決心投身革命.在孟剛女友的協助下,他們成功潛入軍閥陣營,智取軍火送往前線.然而,在與軍閥的激戰中,三人相繼壯烈犧牲,成為湮沒於歷史中的「無名英雄」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gangs girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce ba

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰.太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手.七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭.玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方.五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called Five Poison Web, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親.居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走.富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares hi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到《醉拳》啟發,這部功夫喜劇描述一名傻頭傻腦的功夫小子自創了一套蟋蟀拳,其後更逐一打敗曾欺凌他的武林人士.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by Drunken Master, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍.兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密.珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍.兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密.珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害.明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救.文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. Wi

epg.programme_title_en: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴.這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子.最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主,誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍.在捨身報國的征途中,他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主.面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情,這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and tw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽.二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵.最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will g

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥.陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺.於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上.但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她.畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親.皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a rev

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」,不料該劍顯現出凶兆,將會帶來武林浩劫,而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下.蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖,將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管.數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高,令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial ar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活.豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕.結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品.唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中,希望食唐僧肉而得到永生.悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him!  Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路.未料途中兩具竟逃脫.其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客.更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類.這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心.為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人.中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片,描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況.畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花.兩人互生情愫,不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子.無奈好景不常,不久日軍全面侵入中國,亦正式展開殘酷的統治…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項.事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去.餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂.餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年.他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港.初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救.面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅.兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編.故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任.皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落.劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴.後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sen

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續.七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家,奉命征討宦官專權.展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑.李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位.李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,武義親王恃勢弄權,為奪紫光劍,不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧,並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡,借弔祭為名,實以武力奪劍.甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際,表親徐進到訪,聯手殺退惡奴,但大戰中,徐進、勝男等受傷,無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵……

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who ret

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市.東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中.東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fig

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 男孩小吉的父母離異後,希望尋找快樂的人生.一天,小吉喜遇好心鬼簡人,並結成好友.好心鬼決定要幫助小吉的父母復合,令小吉得到真正的快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧.小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧.小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu m

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗.當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復.幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救.兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, H

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名少林武者對抗販賣奴隸的惡勢力,誓要阻止同胞被賣往美洲金礦淪為苦役.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名建築師發現他已故的父親(曾任希特勒的財政顧問)留下了一筆巨額隱藏財產,意在進行贖罪;然而,這筆遺產卻讓他成為了新納粹分子與陰謀家獵殺的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An architect discovers his late father, who was Hitlers financial advisor, left behind a massive hidden fortune intended to make amends, but he becomes targets for neo-Nazis and conspirators.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on the Marvel Comics character, stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to become a hell-blazing vigilante, to fight against power-hungry Blackheart, the son of the devil himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場秘密任務失敗後,一名士兵幸運逃脫,卻不得不將摯友留在敵人手中.一年後,他冒著失去一切的風險,展開了一場扣人心弦的單槍匹馬救援行動!由湯瑪斯·伊恩·格里菲斯(Thomas Ian Griffith)主演,這是一部充滿爆發力與腎上腺素飆升的終極忠誠傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對感到厭倦的夫妻意外發現兩人竟是效力於競爭機構的頂尖殺手,而他們的下一個任務,就是除掉對方.這場婚姻諮商頓時火藥味十足.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bored married couple discovers they are both elite assassins working for competing agencies—and their next assignment is to eliminate each other. Marriage counseling just got explosive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Maximum Risk, Jean-Claude Van Damme investigates his twin brothers death, leading him from France to New York alongside his brothers girlfriend (Natasha Henstridge) as they flee Russian mobsters and expose an international conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this martial arts adventure set on the eve of WWII, a skilled fighter is hired by Chinese espionage to fight his way up a multi-story tower and retrieve a top-secret military document detailing a planned invasion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果.這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《全力反彈》中,尚-克勞德·范·達美調查雙胞胎兄弟的死因,並與兄弟的女友(娜塔莎·韓絲翠 飾)一同從法國追查到紐約,在逃避俄羅斯黑幫追殺的同時揭開一場國際陰謀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Maximum Risk, Jean-Claude Van Damme investigates his twin brothers death, leading him from France to New York alongside his brothers girlfriend (Natasha Henstridge) as they flee Russian mobsters and expose an international conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事以動盪不安的當代芝加哥為背景,四個毫無共同點的女人,唯一的交集是她們已故丈夫因犯罪活動而留下的債務.她們決定掌握自己的命運,共同謀劃依據自己的方式開創未來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貪腐富豪殺害犯罪目擊者,唯一證人是一名與中國政府有關係的商人之女友.北京保鑣協助香港警方保護她,卻在過程中與證人產生情愫,令任務更加複雜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《全力反彈》中,尚-克勞德·范·達美調查雙胞胎兄弟的死因,並與兄弟的女友(娜塔莎·韓絲翠 飾)一同從法國追查到紐約,在逃避俄羅斯黑幫追殺的同時揭開一場國際陰謀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Maximum Risk, Jean-Claude Van Damme investigates his twin brothers death, leading him from France to New York alongside his brothers girlfriend (Natasha Henstridge) as they flee Russian mobsters and expose an international conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 決定宇宙存亡的終極對決爆發!最後的槍客羅蘭跨越異次元,誓死抵禦黑衣人的邪惡侵襲.一旦黑暗塔倒塌,全宇宙將徹底陷入萬劫不復的深淵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對疏遠的兄弟——一個是成績優異的高材生,另一個則是曾進過感化院的叛逆青年——在加入同一所高中的田徑隊後,不僅得在賽場上激烈競爭,更面臨著情感上的沉重考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two estranged brothers—a straight-A student and a former reform school youth—face intense athletic rivalry and emotional strain when they compete on the same high school track team.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫.當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場秘密任務失敗後,一名士兵幸運逃脫,卻不得不將摯友留在敵人手中.一年後,他冒著失去一切的風險,展開了一場扣人心弦的單槍匹馬救援行動!由湯瑪斯·伊恩·格里菲斯(Thomas Ian Griffith)主演,這是一部充滿爆發力與腎上腺素飆升的終極忠誠傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一部以馬雅文明為背景的冒險電影,講述年輕獵人「美洲豹爪」在被俘並押往獻祭之地後,為了生存並拯救家人而展開的驚險求生之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Mayan adventure film that follows the journey of a young hunter, Jaguar Paw, who must survive and rescue his family after being captured and taken to a sacrificial site.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新詮釋自李曼·法蘭克·鮑姆經典作品《綠野仙蹤》.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A re-imagining of L. Frank Baums classic The Wizard of Oz.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A re-imagining of L. Frank Baums classic The Wizard of Oz.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.programme_title_tc: 聊齋古卷: 蘭若之境
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄,而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相,決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵,一邊互相搞破壞,而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境,花木蘭為老父出征,女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵,屢建戰功,取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際,敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中,趁亂攻城,令他們受到重創。為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幫派紛爭中銷聲匿跡的龍頭阿暿向來獨來獨往,武功了得,更是霍氏醉拳的高手。阿暿隱姓埋名化身為懲治惡勢力的俠客。而行事殘暴的軍閥霄霸天與黑虎山山匪勾結,成立壓榨當地貧民的茶廠 來幫他們種植鴉片。阿暿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Ah Xi is a top martial artist who is also a skilled Huo Drunken Fist fighter. However, she chooses to become an incognito swordswoman who fights against evil. Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..

Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.programme_title_tc: 武狀元蘇乞兒之天降神諭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末期,西方列強在中國橫行霸道,百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭,傳言大清要亡,加上顧命大臣接連暴斃,讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恒徹查此案,富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dreaming of becoming a legendary swordsman, young Yu Dayou is drawn into a deadly conflict over a mythical sword and uncovers a conspiracy between coastal pirates and foreign invaders. After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時,碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出,要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇,便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空,但刺殺失敗,不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一,悟空與龍太子從海里打到南天門。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.programme_title_en: The Whirlwind of Sword and Fairy
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店,但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝,引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後,杜到天台勸女兒回家,父女兩突然被宇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Honest hairstylist Du Chang Rong, raises his daughter on his own and hopes that she will take over his salon. However his daughter dreams of becoming an artiste. In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Jiang Cheng, the secretive Xi He Hall controls the city’s underworld while hunting its legendary former sniper, “Ghost Hand”, branded a traitor. When street hustler Lu Lan impersonates the infamous marksman to make a living, he is captured by the organisation’s deadliest assassin and drawn into a deadly conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡宜寨突然怪病橫行,為了救寨,守山人長生前去尋找傳說中的九色鹿王。另外,大月國王宮內已被妖後控制,太子延頤為了阻止妖後,也踏上尋找九色鹿王的道路。長和延二人在途中要不斷躲避妖後的追殺,幸好有小藜等人幫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Yi Village is hit by a strange disease while the Demon Queen controls the Palace, so Chang and Prince Yan are forced to seek out the legendary Nine-colour Deer King to save the people and stop the Demon Queen. Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐門有一秘寶“洞天儀,可以提前預知惡人名錄。唐門會在此人作惡之前將其殺掉來維護天下太平。一天,唐門掌門唐無煙之名竟也出現於洞天儀之上,無煙被迫逃走,遇到善良小賊楚晨。在其幫助下,她決心殺回唐門尋找真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.programme_title_tc: 聊齋古卷: 蘭若之境
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
