As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王生偶然救了狐妖香兒,在不知香兒真實身分的情況下將她收留在家中,並對她心生愛慕,甚至想納她為妾。原來香兒也是被巫山老妖所控制,操縱她在人間作惡害人。王生和香兒最後能否走在一起,人和妖又能否相戀?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幫派紛爭中銷聲匿跡的龍頭阿暿向來獨來獨往,武功了得,更是霍氏醉拳的高手。阿暿隱姓埋名化身為懲治惡勢力的俠客。而行事殘暴的軍閥霄霸天與黑虎山山匪勾結,成立壓榨當地貧民的茶廠 來幫他們種植鴉片。阿暿..

Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風光旖旎的海島度假酒店遭遇突如其來的海嘯襲擊,與海嘯一起肆虐而來的是一條生猛的巨鯊。曾經作為潛水人員的王磊與朋友Lisa陷入絕境,與他們一同被困的還有與丈夫前來度蜜月的小琳以及蠻橫無理的富家少爺桑尼。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful island resort is devastated by an unexpected tsunami, and the attack of a fierce shark soon follows. A former diver, his friend Lisa, a newlywed couple and a rich young man are trapped on the island. A deadly fight between humans and the shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖以政治獻金收買部長,競逐市長之位洗白勢力。為籌鉅款並剷除對手,他派出鄭吒與神秘打手蘇萬。鄭吒臥底身份不幸曝光,遭貪腐上司陷害,殉職前將未完使命託付蘇萬。面對層層陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A triad boss seeks to clean up his image and win the mayoral seat amid a regime change. To raise funds and eliminate rivals, he sends Zheng Zha and Su Wan into action. When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the tragic loss of his lover, Neua learns Monkey Muay Thai and vows to avenge her death. His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年鍾馗因家鄉慘遭妖族血洗,痛失至親摯愛。背負血海深仇的他決心下山追凶,卻意外邂逅異變成半妖的刁蠻公主,更揭開昔日戀人詭異「復活」背後的跨界奪權陰謀。面對群妖禍害蒼生,鍾馗手持鎮魔聖劍,一路斬妖除魔,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lovers mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪傑武松因揭發嫂子潘金蓮與西門慶的奸情而遭陷害,被迫刺配流放。當得知兄長武大郎慘遭毒殺後,武松悲憤回鄉討回公道,卻發現官府貪贓枉法,拒絕嚴懲真兇。面對黑白顛倒的世道,怒火中燒的武松決意血戰獅子樓,親手..

However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪傑武松因揭發嫂子潘金蓮與西門慶的奸情而遭陷害,被迫刺配流放。當得知兄長武大郎慘遭毒殺後,武松悲憤回鄉討回公道,卻發現官府貪贓枉法,拒絕嚴懲真兇。面對黑白顛倒的世道,怒火中燒的武松決意血戰獅子樓,親手..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武術宗師梁坤為保護心愛的女人毅然退隱江湖,不料他的隱忍卻換來了愛人的慘死。意識到宿命避無可避,他重返武林,在丐幫幫主蘇燦的鼎力相助下,梁坤殺出一條血路,誓要向那些冷血仇敵討回血債。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.programme_title_en: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛山刑警林岩成立精英專案小組,專門重拳打擊囂張跋扈的街頭飛車大盜及其幕後龐大的犯罪集團。然而,當他身懷六甲的妻子慘遭猖狂飛車賊蓄意撞擊,生死未卜之時,極度悲憤的他意外揭開了一場隱匿在黑惡勢力深處的兇險..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..

epg.programme_title_tc: R U Tough Enough: Toughness Redefined
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來自亞洲各區的參賽者,在他們踏上R U Tough Enough的背後故事,他們要在final showdown透過體能和毅力脫?而出,最後優勝者可以得到一萬五千元美金和Southeast Asia的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The growing regional competition R U Tough Enough is searching for the toughest person from Southeast Asia. Join the search and meet some of the most mentally and physically strong individuals, leading up to an epic final showdown in Kuala Lumpur for the prize of US$15,000!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命之樹被燒毀後,世間陷入一片混沌。為拯救蒼生,孫悟空決定回到過去,幫助生命之樹復活。因為失去了金箍棒,孫悟空力量時有時無,只得找回兒時的自己,一同前往尋找時間之力。不料,六耳獼猴卻想據為己有,兩人就..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: CIA探員Tara接受了一項祕密政府實驗,獲得以DNA轉換成任何人的能力,成為終極潛入者。然而,當父親遭到謀殺、線索竟指向她所屬的機構時,Tara被迫脫離組織、展開逃亡。如今,她必須阻止被竊的濃縮鈾引..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個文明崩塌的末日廢土上,賞金獵人Dante靠著格鬥與追蹤求生。一次任務中,他意外掌握關乎世界走向的黑暗機密,觸動統治階層利益,遭軍事組織追殺滅口。走投無路的Dante利用礦洞地形,將追兵誘入死胡同..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, bounty hunter Dante survives on his fighting and tracking skills. During a mission, he uncovers a secret threatening the ruling elite, drawing a deadly manhunt. Cornered, Dante lures his pursuers into an abandoned mine and strikes back, leading survivors to the last untouched land.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天山派傳人玉羅剎連下戰書、誅殺四大掌門,震動武林。武當弟子卓一航應戰不敵,反被其美貌傾倒,二人私定終身。未料江湖傳出卓一航將迎娶師妹何綠華,玉羅剎情傷之下,一夜白頭。她大鬧武當,留下「白髮不復青絲,誓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警探張荼為救落入人販之手的兒子,不惜孤身深入敵穴,跨國追擊,但卻被牽扯進大型兒童拐賣案。在尋找兒子的過程中,他和身份神秘的女子攜手搗毀了一個大型國際犯罪集團,上演了一場驚心動魄的絕地生死營救。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Appearance and Reality
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What would make coupe fans opt for a more traditional two-door model like the Mercedes-Benz E400 instead of its bigger brother, the CLS with four doors? Also: does the Volkswagen Arteon stand a chance against the Mercedes CLS?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We investigate the difference between the Porsche 718 Cayman GTS and the much more expensive 911 GTS. In addition: the third generation of the Mini as a convertible. And: roadster and cabriolet feeling with the facelift of Fiat's 124 Spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The team is shooting a car rollover. Stunt coordinator Carl wants to go all out. He adds an exciting shootout to the mix. Also, he has a surprise for his boss. During the rollover he wants him to sit in the passenger seat, for the very first time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Highfall
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes reveal how spectacular car stunts with big explosions are prepared and which tricks are pulled when you have to blow up a car or jump from a high-rise building.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Jaguar E-Type
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Jaguar E-Type is a century-old sports car whose look still quickens the pulse today. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to build a successor to one of the most beautiful cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Lamborghini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The early history of sports car manufacturer Lamborghini was shaped by the rivalry between tractor manufacturer Ferruccio Lamborghini and Enzo Ferrari. Over the years, the brand launched some of the most striking sports cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Extreme offroad cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We present some of the more extreme specimens in the offroad world: a Fiat Panda monster truck, a Ford Raptor, a conversion of a Mercedes G-class Edition, a modified Volkswagen Touareg, a Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 and the Fiat Panda Cross.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Luxury All Wheelers
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The luxury SUV Infiniti QX70 doesn't need to shy away from a comparison with the Porsche Panamera Turbo S. Also: the unveiling of the Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept in New York. And: test driving the Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI Terrain Tech.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Germany
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it’s the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Mercedes S-Class, BMW's M6 or Audi's A8, premium cars from Germany are the benchmark when it comes to comfort, status, dynamics and driving pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italy
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italy is the land of fashion, design and the most exciting cars of the world. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are considered the epitomes for breathtaking cars, designed with stunning shapes, vivacious engines and incomparable passion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Trailerstunt
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Jaguar E-Type
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Jaguar E-Type is a century-old sports car whose look still quickens the pulse today. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to build a successor to one of the most beautiful cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Lamborghini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The early history of sports car manufacturer Lamborghini was shaped by the rivalry between tractor manufacturer Ferruccio Lamborghini and Enzo Ferrari. Over the years, the brand launched some of the most striking sports cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Extreme offroad cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We present some of the more extreme specimens in the offroad world: a Fiat Panda monster truck, a Ford Raptor, a conversion of a Mercedes G-class Edition, a modified Volkswagen Touareg, a Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 and the Fiat Panda Cross.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Luxury All Wheelers
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The luxury SUV Infiniti QX70 doesn't need to shy away from a comparison with the Porsche Panamera Turbo S. Also: the unveiling of the Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept in New York. And: test driving the Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI Terrain Tech.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Germany
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it’s the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Mercedes S-Class, BMW's M6 or Audi's A8, premium cars from Germany are the benchmark when it comes to comfort, status, dynamics and driving pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italy
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italy is the land of fashion, design and the most exciting cars of the world. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are considered the epitomes for breathtaking cars, designed with stunning shapes, vivacious engines and incomparable passion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Trailerstunt
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Vive la France
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We were allowed to drive a car of Citroen's sub-brand DS who try to set foot in the Formula E. In addition: Citroen and Peugeot share the same platform with their Rifter and Berlingo models. And: the facelift of the 508, Peugeot's flagship car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Sneak Previews
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eager to overcome the damage to their image following the diesel scandal, Volkswagen allowed exclusive sneak peaks into future developments. We took their T-Cross on a covered drive. In addition: a first glance at Audi's A1 and A6 models.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Behind the Scene
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reporter Dean Malay takes a look behind the scenes of Action Concept and shows the real people behind the Stunt Heroes’ tough-guy image. Coordinator Domi explains the workflows and reveals why stuntman Tobi is called Heidi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Bike Crash
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time the team deals with motorbike stunts: high jumps, risky drops and dangerous crashes in the company's backyard. Stunt coordinator Domi requires his specialists to be in top shape and extremely focused.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Opel Classics
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 1960s and 1970s were golden years for Opel. Ascona, Manta, Rekord and GT, an Opel was more than just a car, and the company built one classic after another. Today, these car models are all icons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mercedes-Benz S-Class
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz S-Class has set the standard in the luxury class. The status model of the rich, famous and powerful prevails against crises, social change and all competitors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - The Four Elements
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Four elements, four 4x4's. The Audi Q3 feels at home on city streets and gravel roads, the Nissan Qashqai defeats the wind, the Porsche Macan Turbo clashes with the desert heat, and the amphibian car Volkswagen Schwimmwagen crosses the Danube river.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Pickups
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Europe pickups are mainly used commercially. In the US these trucks are as common as SUVs. We compared the Volkswagen Amarok to the Toyota Hilux. Also: current US pickups, the Chevrolet Colorado and GMC's Sierra and Canyon.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Highlights Geneva Motor Show
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Highlights Geneva Motor Show
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Highlights Geneva Motor Show
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Geneva Motor Show is the first European auto show of the year where manufacturers from all over the world showcase their newest design studies, concept cars and production models. Also: a closer look at Volkswagen's Eco Up!.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - SUVs - On The Fast Lane!
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - SUVs - On The Fast Lane!
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - SUVs - On The Fast Lane!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The SUV trend has been going on for many years. We took a look at some of the competitors, like the Porsche Cayenne with its S, GTS and Turbo models, Subaru's updated Forrester and Audi's RS Q3. Also: the Mini Countryman.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Legendary Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ferrari 250 GTO, Porsche 911, Aston Martin DB 5 or Lamborghini Aventador and Ferrari LaFerrari - every era produces fabulous dream cars, born from the fascination for breathtaking design and the dream for outstanding speed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Mighty Four-Cylinders
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We compared the Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost turbo to BMW's 430i with similar engine and drive specs. Also: Lada tries to take on Dacia with their Vesta SW station wagon. And: Opel's Grandland X may be an SUV, but it doesn't offer an all-wheel drive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Asia Snacks
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is Kia's visually exciting Stinger able to convince in our test? In addition: we explored how Subaru's Boxer engine concept works in their XV model. And: Hyundai i30N vs. Volkswagen Golf GTI.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Ferruccio Lamborghini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Ferry Porsche
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Ambulance
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stunt coordinator Domi’s latest idea for the Stunt Heroes team involves an old ambulance that is prepared so that the stuntman can jump right through the ambulance with his car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Matrix
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts specialist Ramazan creates a fight choreography that involves four stuntmen who play secret agents that try to nail him down. And somebody will spectacularly take off with a car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Power Offroader
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Porsche Cayenne Turbo and the Range Rover Supercharged are powerful and luxurious offroaders. We put these high-performance SUVs to the off-road test. Also: the Brabus B 63 S 700 Wide-Star is in fact a souped-up Mercedes GL 63 AMG.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Offroad Minis
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small 4x4's are on the rise, as it doesn't need to be size that matters when it comes to having fun in the city or off-road. We take a look at mini SUVs, the Fiat's 500 X, the Cross Polo and Cross up! by Volkswagen and BMW's X1 XDrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Kiekert
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The German company Kiekert is a supplier for locking systems and the market leader in side door locks. Their products keep cars secure against theft, prevent doors from opening while driving and have a life-saving function in case of an accident.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - 125 years Mercedes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cars from Mercedes-Benz stand for quality and safety. Again and again throughout its more than 125 years-long history this manufacturer set new standards in automotive engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Off the road
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Primm 300 in the Mojave desert in Nevada is one of the toughest desert races in the world. Also: Mitsubishi's mini multi-purpose vehicle Space Star. And: Mercedes-Benz' SUVenture, a three-day tour through the desert of Oman.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Topless on the road
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Topless on the road
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Topless on the road
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convertibles suggest to the feeling of freedom while driving a car. We took a look at what Opel's Cascada and Adam convertible models had to offer. Also: what does the BMW 3 series Gran Turismo have in common with its bigger brother from the 5 series?

epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Topless on the road
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Topless on the road
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convertibles suggest to the feeling of freedom while driving a car. We took a look at what Opel's Cascada and Adam convertible models had to offer. Also: what does the BMW 3 series Gran Turismo have in common with its bigger brother from the 5 series?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Luxury Treats
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since its introduction in 1983 the Opel Combo has been very successful with both craftspeople and families alike. We took a look at the updated version. Also: with the XC40, Volvo introduced a new mobility concept called Care by Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Value-for-Money Kings
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kia provides good cars at fair prices. We tested the Kia Stinger for its everyday use in Munich's city center. In addition: Seat's sports sub-brand Cupra introduced the Ateca, a rather affordable performance SUV. And: a crossover for the city, the Fiat 500X.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Chevrolet
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The history of Chevrolet, from the beginnings to the later successful Bel Air and Impala and the current Corvette and Camaro models, as well as Chevrolet's motorsport history from Le Mans to Indianapolis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mercedes-Benz SL-Class
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes are still at the ski resort, preparing a spectacular stunt involving a station wagon that is catapulted 50 meters high into the air. The high-flying car is supposed to crash into another car that is placed on a meadow.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Body Stunt Highlights
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode features the most spectacular classic body stunts: jumping from rooftops or the top of a driving cars, falling down staircases, and other potentially bone-breaking daredevilry, including fails and outtakes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Low-Price SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low-priced SUVs frequently lead in the sales statistics and also do fine in independent benchmark tests. We examine the pros and cons of affordable SUVs like the Suzuki Jimny, the Dacia Duster and the Russian SUV veteran, the Lada Niva.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Fun factor All-Wheel Drive
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We present Mercedes-Benz' all-wheel-drive range of cars and take the German brand's GLA250 and S500 4matic to the Austrian Alps. Also: drifting fun with the Fiat Freemont Cross and the Volvo V40 Cross Country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Alpina
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alpina stands for modern engineering, high precision in engine design and finest materials. The company specializes in premium BMW tuning, successful motorsports and - surprisingly - special wines.

epg.programme_title_tc: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.programme_title_en: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a design competition eight BMW models are shortlisted and presented to 500 test customers. A jury recommends two models for the finale and then the winner of the design contest will be announced and produced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Volkner Mobile
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With its length of up to 12 meters and its weight of 18 tons, the Performance by Volkner is the most extraordinary luxury motor home from Germany and one of the most exclusive caravans in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Mechatronics
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pleidelsheim, near Stuttgart. The Mechatronik company specialises in classics from Mercedes. Since 1997, engineers, electricians and mechanics has dedicated itself to the restoration and refinement of classic models.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Luxury Treats
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since its introduction in 1983 the Opel Combo has been very successful with both craftspeople and families alike. We took a look at the updated version. Also: with the XC40, Volvo introduced a new mobility concept called Care by Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Chevrolet
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The history of Chevrolet, from the beginnings to the later successful Bel Air and Impala and the current Corvette and Camaro models, as well as Chevrolet's motorsport history from Le Mans to Indianapolis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mercedes-Benz SL-Class
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Alarm in the Ski Resort
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes are still at the ski resort, preparing a spectacular stunt involving a station wagon that is catapulted 50 meters high into the air. The high-flying car is supposed to crash into another car that is placed on a meadow.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Body Stunt Highlights
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode features the most spectacular classic body stunts: jumping from rooftops or the top of a driving cars, falling down staircases, and other potentially bone-breaking daredevilry, including fails and outtakes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Low-Price SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low-priced SUVs frequently lead in the sales statistics and also do fine in independent benchmark tests. We examine the pros and cons of affordable SUVs like the Suzuki Jimny, the Dacia Duster and the Russian SUV veteran, the Lada Niva.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Fun factor All-Wheel Drive
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We present Mercedes-Benz' all-wheel-drive range of cars and take the German brand's GLA250 and S500 4matic to the Austrian Alps. Also: drifting fun with the Fiat Freemont Cross and the Volvo V40 Cross Country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Alpina
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alpina stands for modern engineering, high precision in engine design and finest materials. The company specializes in premium BMW tuning, successful motorsports and - surprisingly - special wines.

epg.programme_title_tc: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.programme_title_en: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a design competition eight BMW models are shortlisted and presented to 500 test customers. A jury recommends two models for the finale and then the winner of the design contest will be announced and produced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Volkner Mobile
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With its length of up to 12 meters and its weight of 18 tons, the Performance by Volkner is the most extraordinary luxury motor home from Germany and one of the most exclusive caravans in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Mechatronics
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pleidelsheim, near Stuttgart. The Mechatronik company specialises in classics from Mercedes. Since 1997, engineers, electricians and mechanics has dedicated itself to the restoration and refinement of classic models.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Luxury Treats
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since its introduction in 1983 the Opel Combo has been very successful with both craftspeople and families alike. We took a look at the updated version. Also: with the XC40, Volvo introduced a new mobility concept called Care by Volvo.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Club of Station Wagons
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Club of Station Wagons
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Club of Station Wagons
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Porsche packed a lot of power into the Panamera. We took their Sport Turismo model to the Formula One track in Bahrain. In addition: BMW redesigned their 530i Touring 4-cylinder station wagon. And: an trip to Cologne in the Volvo V60.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Small, but fast
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beside SUVs, compact and city cars are on the rise. For many people, a Kia Picanto is enough to satisfy their mobility needs. In addition: the Audi A1 offers certain features of the luxury class, but at a much higher price. And: the agile Kia Ceed GT.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Car Action Highlights
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rollovers, ramp jumps, crashes - there are thousands of ways to destroy cars, and the Stunt Heroes produce a lot of wrecks over the course of their adrenaline-filled job. It's a look back at the car stunt highlights of the past episodes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Special - Stunt Highlights
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Class reunion
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We started a rather unusual race between an S-train and an Audi S3. Also: some of the highlights of the Shanghai Auto Show. And: Mercedes-Benz invested a lot of money in the facelift of their E-Class in order to put their competitors in place.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Tuning World
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For more than 20 years the Tuning World Bodensee has been one of the top events in the European car tuning scene. Also: with their i-models BMW started to explore alternative drive technologies. And: taking the Nissan Leaf to Oslo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Rallye Breslau
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2014, 103 participants took part in the Rally Breslau Balkan, chasing their motorcycles, quads, or all-wheel all-terrain vehicles through rivers and over tree trunks. We accompanied these offroad enthusiasts on their race against time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Real Winners
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When BMW released the X6 in 2008, many people doubted that this concept would be successful. We took a look at the second generation of this model in the M50d version. Also: test driving the best-selling Opel Mokka. And: the Mercedes GLE Coupe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The White Army
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes leave their headquarters and travel to a ski resort. They simulate the attack of an army of soldiers all dressed in white. As part of this scene they want to make a car explode and fly through the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the very beginning of its company history, AMG has set itself the goal of being the epitome of automotive top performance, exclusivity and dynamic driving pleasure under the sign of the Mercedes star.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Lancia
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary racing successes, technological innovations and exclusive vehicles were main contributors to the Lancia brand's worldwide fame. Its history was marked by ups and downs, but Lancia is still held in high esteem.

epg.programme_title_en: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Saint-Denis / Île de la Réunion
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Saint-Denis / Île de la Réunion
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Round three takes X-Trial to Saint-Denis on Réunion Island. The championship returns to the French overseas territory as the world's top riders tackle a spectacular indoor course and battle for vital points in the early title fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Classic Races - Rally World Championship, 1982
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1982, the African continent held many challenges for the participants of the Rally World Championship. Heat, dust, mud and ever-changing tracks posed major problems for the drivers, co-drivers and their machines.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Classic Races - BMW Motorsport, Season 1976
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s the 3 Litre BMW CSL was one of the dream cars in the Bavarian manufacturer's motorsports history. In the 1976 season not only this model celebrated successes in several international racing competitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 11
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone covers Italian F4 at Misano, where Alp Aksoy and Luka Sammalisto make their mark, before Ferrari Challenge UK heads to Snetterton with Gilbert and Bradley Yates, Joseph Dean and Chris Beighton among the leading names in action.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 12
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone mixes three championships: European Truck Racing at Misano, Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland at the Red Bull Ring and DTM at Zandvoort. Norbert Kiss, Keegan Masters, Flynt Schuring and Matteo Cairoli are among the standout drivers.

epg.programme_title_tc: On Tour - Bus Stunts with Action Concept
epg.programme_title_en: On Tour - Bus Stunts with Action Concept
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - Bus Stunts with Action Concept
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Action Concept is one of the biggest action film production companies in Europe, specializing in exciting and breathtaking stunt work. We visited one of their sets in order to witness the filming of a spectacular bus stunt.

epg.programme_title_tc: On Tour - ADAC Bavaria Historic Rallye
epg.programme_title_en: On Tour - ADAC Bavaria Historic Rallye
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - ADAC Bavaria Historic Rallye
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the Bavaria Historic Rally, a smaller counterpart to the world-famous Mille Miglia in Italy, it's not about power and speed. We feature some of the automotive gems at this classic car event and hear what their owners have to say.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: EnduroGP heads to Darfo Boario Terme in Italy, where Verona, Garcia and Pichon face rain, slippery rocks and brutal Alpine terrain in a dramatic penultimate round packed with crashes and title pressure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Calm, posed and serene, Andrea Pirlo, the architect of the Italian triumph of 2006, had a style very much of his own. But this was also true of Germany in 1990 and the strategies of Brazil's golden age.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您曾否想過為何山魈的臉如此七彩,禿鷹為何禿頭,甚至雙髻鯊為何有雙髻?發掘動物如何通過脖子以上的進化來生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭、飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地理和生物學尺度上,人類只是霎眼間的存在罷了,但我們卻影響了許多動物的進化路徑.探索人類對狗、狼、郊狼和大象等的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet weve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆、當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁、開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石、一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫、遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥瓜達盧普島附近,頂尖鯊魚生態學家莫利斯奧許尤士先使用遙視.他將攝影機安裝在大白鯊的鰭上,拍攝到一個獨特的視野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩獵,並且最終襲擊獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的荒野是一個難以生存的地方.這裡許多動物都必須成群結隊來幫忙保衛領土、保護後代、覓食和對抗掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆、當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁、開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石、一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚經常被描繪成容易攻擊人類的無腦進食機器,但是它們的行為比之前所認為的更加複雜和聰明.找出這些優雅的頂級捕食者如何互動,選擇朋友,甚至訓導其他同類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度、狡猾和敏捷?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.
