epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公里的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibias wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. Its a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoos five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoos five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. Its a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queenslands ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, its a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費里曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費里曼的人生旅程——從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman—his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日.但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具. 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie celebrates her 65th birthday in 2024. But she is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic and way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a childrens sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到荷里活的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展、個人生活、心理健康、慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從百老匯舞台到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華、最全能的表演者之一.這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉「金鋼狼」一角名揚全球的星路歷程.透過舞台上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員、歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Broadway to blockbuster, Hugh Jackman is one of the most versatile performers of his generation. This documentary traces his journey from humble Australian beginnings to global stardom as Wolverine. Through stage triumphs and personal challenges

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
epg.programme_title_en: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

epg.programme_title_en: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jacksons status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過、她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Kamala Harriss rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生——從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係、與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖、最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston — from her gospel roots to global superstardom — unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭、翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩、侏儒象、長鼻猴、犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. Theres room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ  Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ  Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ  Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ  Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到荷里活聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With over 50 years in the industry, not many filmmakers can boast the longevity and influence of Steven Spielberg, whose journey from the suburbs of Arizona to the spotlight of Hollywood is one of the greatest stories ever told.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去、現在和未來打拼.他被稱為「電影保母」,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoos five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igors company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空、競賽、火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去、現在和未來打拼.他被稱為「電影保母」,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, thats never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omars FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, hell create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ  Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ  Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭、翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩、侏儒象、長鼻猴、犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoos five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空、競賽、火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, natures most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ  Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ  Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過、她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Kamala Harriss rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭、翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩、侏儒象、長鼻猴、犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to  Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

One trail leads Callum to bustling Parliament Square, where it’s believed the St Bernard types are being used to get passers-by to part with their cash. Will he manage to find the dogs that he is looking for?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt and the keepers at Flamingoland come up with a cunning plan as they face the difficult task of trying to move a three and a half ton white rhino to Sweden. On a much smaller scale,  an abandoned rabbit with an urgent dental problem and Matt discovers that picking up a penguin isn't as easy as it sounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At a house in Hull, Inspector Claire Little rescues two flea infested Staffordshire Bull Terriers named Roxy and Madison that are missing half of their fur. As Claire begins her investigation, will the scratching Staffies be able to recover?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From rams to lizards, many animals rely on direct body-to-body combat. This episode uncovers headbutts, wrestling, and full-on melees in the natural world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: We delve into the world of flies, exploring ehtir annoying habits, vast numbers, and surprising benefits. Discover their fascinating behaviors, contributions to medical science, and unique adaptations that make them one of the most successful groups of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: We explore the complex and ften misunderstood world o snakes. Feared for their deadly venom and silent movements, snakes have also been revered as symbols of wisdom and health. This episode delves into the myths and realities of snakes, uncovering their fascinating behaviors, cultural significance, and the reaons behind our deep-seated fears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. Only you won’t believe how some animals see the world....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: We delve into the world of flies, exploring ehtir annoying habits, vast numbers, and surprising benefits. Discover their fascinating behaviors, contributions to medical science, and unique adaptations that make them one of the most successful groups of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: “Tentacles” follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean Island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思試圖營救被劫持為人質的道克,結果自己也被抓住了.康拉德向眾人譴責他是與移民勾結作惡的罪犯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth tries to rescue Doc, whos been taken hostage, and ends up captured himself. Konrad denounces him to the people as a criminal who colluded with the immigrants to do evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十五年前,年幼的哈梅林被感染後,與其他三名感染兒童一起被囚禁在隆隆鎮.當宗教裁判所的奧克蘇馬雷少校挺身而出保護孩子們時,年輕的康拉德殺死了他,並嫁禍給孩子們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fifteen years ago, a young Hameline, having been infected, was imprisoned in Rumble Town along with three other infected children. When Major Oxumare of the Inquisition stands up for the children, a young Konrad kills him and frames the children.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dantes Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Khun learns the truth from Hwaryun and decides to join Wangnans team in the Workshop Battle. Meanwhile, Bam remains on Team FUG as Viole.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Workshop Manager Io announces a game in which all participants will compete for a spot on the floating ship. As each team prepares for the start of the game, Viole rescues a Traveller being chased by a security robot in a back alley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 康拉德手持巨矛,是個難纏的對手.經過一番苦戰,賽斯最終擊敗了康拉德,但哈梅琳已經開始摧毀城鎮.她攻擊塞斯時,將他擊飛,昏迷過去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Konrad makes a formidable foe with his giant lance. After a grueling fight, Seth finally defeats Konrad, but the collapse of the town has already begun by Hamelines hand. When she attacks Seth, he is sent flying and loses consciousness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最終,塞斯與哈梅琳正面交鋒.哈梅琳一邊對他發動猛烈攻擊,一邊斷言這座小鎮不值得拯救.賽斯一直以來都用魔法保護人們,但當他意識到自己和哈梅琳其實並沒有太大差別時,開始對她產生了同情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At last, Seth faces Hameline. She asserts that the town isnt worth saving as she unleashes fierce attacks on him. Seth has always used his magic to protect people, but begins to sympathize with Hameline as he realizes that theyre not so different.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休殺手法蘭克,人稱「沉默者」.想跟他的新女友和她女兒過上正常的生活,但黑手黨老大要他為年幼的女兒的死報仇,他身不由己地重出江湖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired hitman, Frank, known as The Silencer wants to lead a normal life with his new girlfriend and her daughter but is unwillingly brought back into the game when a mafia mob boss wants him to avenge the death of his young daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hameline is defeated by General Torque, the Beast. The enraged Seth continues to fight, but Von Teppes of the Inquisition turns the tables on him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當塞斯一行人回到阿爾忒彌斯學院時,他們被奉為揭露審判官罪行的英雄.但當塞斯想起哈梅琳,想起自己在戰場上的所作所為時,他拒絕接受小鎮的讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Seth and company return to Artemis Academy, they are welcomed as the heroes who exposed the misdeeds of an Inquisitor. But when Seth thinks about Hameline, and about his own actions in battle, he refuses to accept the towns accolades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔瑪克提君恩的軍隊接近霸巴和他的家人,瑪格拉的過去被揭露.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The twins reach a crossroads in their journey to the House of Enlightenment.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy joins Talamasca and is sent to London on his first mission. Helen trains him to be a spy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蓋伊對塔拉馬斯卡的信任產生了懷疑.海倫向蓋伊講述了「七五二」的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy questions his trust in the Talamasca. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy questions his trust in the Talamasca. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲得登船證的參賽者們在阿基米德號上稍作休息.坤在船上與拉克重逢.他們決心從FUG手中奪回維奧萊(巴姆),「旗幟」工坊之戰終於打響!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The participants that acquired boarding passes enjoy a moments rest aboard the Archimedes. Khun is reunited with Rak on the floating ship. With their determination to take back Viole (Bam) from FUG, the Flag Workshop Battle finally begins!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊戲一開始,王楠,王子和阿克拉普託就被迫與被維爾迪的能力逼瘋的米森戰鬥.他們無法與米森溝通,該如何阻止她的暴走?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the game begins, Wangnan, Prince, and Akraptor are forced to fight against Miseng, who has been driven mad by Verdis ability. Unable to communicate with Miseng, how will they stop her rampage?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯啟程前往首都,卻被一艘商人的飛艇攔截.多虧格林的幫助,塞斯才僥倖逃脫,並成功抵達首都,在那裡他遇到了道克和梅莉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth sets out for the capital but gets intercepted by a Merchant-Baron airship. Seth barely escapes thanks to Grimm, and successfully reaches the capital where he encounters Doc and Melie.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯試圖進入城堡的檔案館,結果被趕了出來!之後,塞斯結識了奧科霍,並與她並肩作戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After attempting to enter the castles archives, Seth gets kicked out! Seth is later introduced to Ocoho and joins her in battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賽斯和奧科霍與強大的幽靈復仇者幫展開對決,同時試圖保護一個小農場免於破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth and Ocoho face off against a powerful Spectral Nemesis band while attempting to protect a small farm from destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在魔鬼孩子王中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子.這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作,幽默和感人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dantes Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.programme_title_en: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

They have documented the signs of global warming and raise the new generation’s awareness through social
networks.

The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the fastest growing Christian church on earth and here The Holy Spirit truly flows. Host Tevya joins the boisterous celebration of worship at a Pentecostal Revival church where speaking in tongues, writhing on the floor and spiritual healing are all part of the faith experience. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

epg.programme_title_tc: Messages from the End of the World
epg.programme_title_en: Messages from the End of the World
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The documentary describes the dramatic consequences of the climate change in the Arctic zone. Thanks to the Swiss Arctic Project five young people have been navigating for three weeks through hostile and beautiful landscapes up to the North. They have documented the signs of global warming and raise the new generation’s awareness through social
networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.
